plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the dominant strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Since the third-price auction mechanism means I only pay the third-highest bid, I want to bid strategically. My value is $31, so I'll bid just below that to maximize potential profit while ensuring I have a good chance of winning. A bid around $30.9 seems optimal - close to my true value but leaving a small margin of potential profit.

In a first-price sealed bid auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically below one's true value. Since my value is $37, I want to maximize potential profit. Given rational opponents, I'll bid slightly below my true value to leave room for potential profit, but high enough to have a good chance of winning. A bid around $35-$36 seems optimal.

In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the dominant strategy is to bid strategically around my private value.
